hero.headline: Become the Hunter.
subline: The market doesn’t pay those who chase every move.
It rewards those who wait for the perfect prey.

panels.headline: Every Hunt Begins With a Scenario.
subline: Hunters don’t improvise. They prepare for
every possible move before the hunt begins.

panels.headline: Know Your Hunting Hours
subline: Track each trading session and discover
when your strategy performs at its best.

panels.headline: Decide Before You Strike.
subline: Set your rules before the market moves,
so when the moment comes, you already know what to do.
